population.description: Targets with zero candidates after items-only production candidate generation

interpretation_notes: NOT_FOUND_AFTER_SEARCH means that no corresponding work-level Wikidata item was identified during the additional manual search; it does not prove that no such item exists.
scope_review_prelim is a preliminary scope judgment and is intentionally kept separate from the Wikidata entity-resolution judgment.
The sample was frozen before manual inspection using random_state=20260918.
The audit is diagnostic of the zero-candidate population and was not used to tune the frozen v6 judge.

Detailed per-record search provenance (for example, all queries and URLs) was not retained for all 100 records; the manual-review TSV records the resulting judgments and should therefore be treated as a diagnostic audit.
